gao-gaoreports-gao-08-586g:
Federal audit guidance is issued in the Financial Audit Manual, volume 2, GAO-08-586G, dated July 25, 2008. GAO and the President's Council on Integrity and Efficiency jointly maintain the manual. It tells auditors how to perform financial statement audits of federal entities.

This volume sets out the working guidance auditors follow on real engagements, from planning and testing to reporting. It includes the forms and checklists audit teams use, such as review sign-offs for agreed-upon procedures work. The manual is a core tool for holding agencies accountable for taxpayer funds. Auditors across the government rely on it to keep federal audits consistent and sound. It is a reference work rather than a report on any single agency.
